blocks.p: Angel puts stock back on the shelves of the station. The *Character* window holds what he carries; the *World* window holds the containers around him.

The badge over the container buttons of each window counts the containers open in it, and each container has a column of its own. Each column header gives the container's name, its weight against what it holds at most, and the number of items in it. To move an item, drag it from one column to another.
Angel's backpack holds the stock: candy, chips, cigarettes and colas. The row of the item being dragged is lit in its column.
